features.name: Harness baseline (install + verification)
features.description: A clean checkout can install the SensitiveGuard toolchain and run the quality gate and test suite via ./init.sh with a green result.
features.evidence: ./init.sh => ruff check clean, ruff format --check clean, 310 passed in ~34s, compileall clean (2026-08-23).

features.name: Intent model, resolver and guard
features.description: Signed IntentSpec ceiling with rule-based operation inference, capability/effect derivation, and plan validation (src/sensitiveguard/intent/).

features.name: Dynamic request-intent binding
features.description: Bind the current guarded user prompt to a signed child intent that can only narrow the host ceiling, never expand it (src/sensitiveguard/dynamic_agent.py).
features.evidence: Built-in and host-registered capabilities/effects derive only from surviving effective_operations. tests/sensitiveguard/test_dynamic_agent.py::test_user_prompt_cannot_expand_host_authority passes; full suite 310 passed.

features.name: Detectors (encoded / injection / normalization)
features.description: Sensitive-data and prompt-injection detection over normalized and encoded inputs (src/sensitiveguard/detector/).
features.evidence: Detection covered across the SensitiveGuard suite (310 passing); walkthrough in examples/sensitiveguard/detection/.

features.name: Privacy routing
features.description: Route models and destinations by detection result, forbidding silent external fallback (src/sensitiveguard/routing/).

features.name: Review engine and permits
features.description: Policy review and signed permits governing capability execution (src/sensitiveguard/review/).

features.name: Runtime: capability manifest, safe command, egress inspector, gateway
features.description: Capability-scoped tool gateway, fail-closed command execution, and egress inspection/masking (src/sensitiveguard/runtime/).

features.name: Lineage tracking
features.description: Track data lineage/provenance and mark failed side effects as indeterminate rather than committed (src/sensitiveguard/lineage/).

features.name: Audit logging and sanitization
features.description: Structured audit events with private-canary sanitization so secrets never enter logs (src/sensitiveguard/audit/).
features.evidence: Audit sanitization asserted across the SensitiveGuard suite (310 passing).

features.name: Evaluation and acceptance harness
features.description: Executable benchmark, scenario runner, sinks and acceptance report (src/sensitiveguard/eval/).
features.evidence: Five-layer B0-B4 harness covered by test_benchmark_harness.py and test_demo_server.py; examples/sensitiveguard/README.md now documents the internal gate, real-model runs, custom JSONL, and end-to-end AgentDojo, AgentThreatBench, PrivacyLens, AgentDAM, BFCL, and tau3 workflows. `./init.sh` => 310 passed and `python -m sensitiveguard.eval` => B4 PASS across 30 scenarios / 150 runs (2026-08-23).

features.name: Full-repo quality gate (whole tree)
features.description: Extend the green baseline to `make quality` and `make test` across the entire repo, not just the sensitiveguard scope, so CI parity is guaranteed.

features.name: External benchmark single-case B0-B4 walkthrough
features.description: Pin one public AgentDojo, PrivacyLens, BFCL, and tau3 sample and replay the identical raw candidate through B0-B4 with observable tool, detection, transformation, intent, memory, audit, and transparent local-score events.
features.evidence: Four pinned fixtures plus a deterministic B0-B4 walkthrough CLI and transparent local scorers are covered by tests/sensitiveguard/test_external_eval_walkthrough.py. Focused tests: 20 passed; BFCL JSON CLI smoke passed; ./init.sh: ruff/format/compileall clean and 327 passed (2026-08-27).
